basis: Every complete relation path dictionary inspected; no selected case evidence reviewed and no semantic judgments entered at declaration.

declarations.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
declarations.definition: Organization or business unit X is a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational part of parent organization Y.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves prior child-to-parent subsidiary/unit scope. Explicit part, unit, subsidiary or owned-by qualifies. Ordinary employment, a geographic site standing for an unnamed unit, and partial investment alone do not establish the same fact.

declarations.label: analyst at organization
declarations.definition: Person X is an analyst at, with or for organization Y.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves specific analyst affiliation. Director, economist, strategist, partner or broad employment alone does not establish analyst; role/attachment ambiguity is kept explicit.

declarations.label: defeated opponent
declarations.definition: X defeated opposing competitor Y in at least one competitive contest.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves prior winner-to-opponent scope. Beat, defeat, completed sweep, outscore or victory over qualifies. Playing, facing, standings, losing, trades or transfers alone do not. A historical win remains supported when other rows describe losses; flag the mixed evidence.

declarations.label: president or manager of
declarations.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team or institution Y.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves the earlier combined president/manager scope. Generic head, leadership, ownership, coach or ordinary employee alone does not establish these offices. Truncated personal-principal arguments may omit a campaign/organization and require review.

declarations.label: leader or organizational head of
declarations.definition: Person X holds or held a leadership or head office in political body or organization Y.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves prior leader/head scope, including legislative leadership and explicit president/chair office. Simple membership, founding, affiliation, legal representation or an athletic lead does not qualify.

declarations.label: coach of
declarations.definition: Person X coaches or holds/held coach office for team or athletic institution Y.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves coach-specific scope. Manager/president, player participation, vacancy consideration or ordinary affiliation alone is insufficient.

declarations.label: defeated opponent
declarations.definition: X defeated opposing competitor Y in at least one competitive contest.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves prior winner-to-opponent scope. Beat, defeat, completed sweep, outscore or victory over qualifies. Playing, facing, standings, losing, trades or transfers alone do not. A historical win remains supported when other rows describe losses; flag the mixed evidence. The largest individual path is play (26), with beat (16), loss-to (10), lose-to (9) and face (6). A broader played-against interpretation is plausible. This primary audit retains the previous defeated-opponent predicate for comparability; do not switch after seeing the five case judgments. Record the competing interpretation separately.

declarations.label: economist at organization
declarations.definition: Person X is an economist at, with, for or of organization Y.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves economist-specific affiliation. Professor, president, analyst or strategist alone is insufficient; do not use external biography to fill an absent role.

declarations.label: director of organization
declarations.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit director office in organization or institution Y.
declarations.scope_notes: Director-for/of/possessive/noun constructions are the leading family. Preserve the earlier director-specific scope. Spokesperson, adviser, confidante, lobbyist or chairwoman alone is a competing role; do not broaden to general affiliation.

declarations.label: managerial or leadership office in
declarations.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or institution Y, such as chairperson, head, director, president, manager, chief or executive.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves prior organizational office family. The dictionary combines qualifying offices; founder, owner, analyst, ordinary employment or sporting lead alone is insufficient. Historical offices qualify.

declarations.label: managerial or leadership office in
declarations.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or institution Y, such as chairperson, head, director, president, manager, chief or executive.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves prior organizational office family. The dictionary combines qualifying offices; founder, owner, analyst, ordinary employment or sporting lead alone is insufficient. Historical offices qualify.

declarations.label: organization based or located in
declarations.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographical place Y.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves organization-location scope. Explicit firm/company-in, based-in or headquarters evidence qualifies. Industry, personal residence/birth, nationality alone or non-place corporate affiliation does not.

declarations.label: winner or champion of
declarations.definition: X won competition, race, championship, prize or award Y.
declarations.scope_notes: Preserves event/award winner scope. Event Y differs from a defeated opponent or an issuing organization. Participation, finishing, winning one stage or travel alone does not establish winning the entire event.

declarations.label: born in
declarations.definition: Person X was born in geographical place Y.
declarations.scope_notes: Declare the coherent birthplace meaning from dominant born-in/born-into-family-in paths. Growing up, schooling, residence, nationality, work or later travel alone does not establish birthplace. This is a new explicit meaning where the prior common catalogue has no matching sampled relation.
